about_the_game:
Welcome to our hotel, where anyone could be a guest. Ghost? Ancient deity? Character from a famous fairy tale? But the staff here is not so ordinary either.

From now on, you are a new employee of this hotel. A friendly team and interesting tasks to keep you waiting for more. Your job description? Be ready to become a jack of all trades!

Everybody here has their own story, everybody has a skeleton in their closet (apart from Jeff from room 7 - because he is the skeleton). Learn more about the scary fairytales within the walls of the most friendly hotel in all the worlds!

And keep in mind: the most important thing is to pass the probationary period. From there on, it will definitely get easier!

Gameplay:

  • Join in the hotel

    • Check-in: choose a suitable room, according to the preferences and special requests of the guests.

    • Room Service: deliver food, run errands, and help with guests' hotel-related problems.

    • Conflict management: resolve disputes between guests or employees, this will affect their attitude towards you and each other.

  • Interactivity

    • Guest engagement: requests range from cooking unique meals (e.g. custom potion orders) to helping find lost items (or even guests!) in rooms.

    • Entertainment activities: dinner with visitors and staff, weekend adventures with friends, opportunities to be a photographer and gather a sticker collection.

  • Social interactions

    • Developing relationships with your colleagues, from platonic to romantic. Each character has its own story. How each character story reveals - depends only on you!

    • The decisions that you make during the working day determine not only the story, but also the ending of the game.

  • Variety of endings

    • Different endings depend on how you fulfill your duties, your relationships, and your key choices in certain moments.

    • Diversity of endings: romantic outcomes, revealing the secrets of the hotel, or even its destruction (if everything goes wrong). Experience them all!

content_descriptors.notes: This game may contain content not appropriate for all ages. It contains General Mature Content, and may covered nudity and sexual outfits.
